# LexisNexis

> > LexisNexis is a global leader in legal intelligence, AI-powered research, and risk management solutions for legal professionals, enterprises, and risk management organizations.

LexisNexis provides comprehensive legal research platforms, AI-powered drafting and workflow tools, risk solutions including fraud detection and identity verification, and professional services across multiple verticals. The platform serves legal professionals, corporations, and risk management teams through integrated solutions like Lexis+, Lexis+ AI, Accurint, and specialized risk management tools.

## Key Topics

- Lexis+
- Lexis+ AI
- Legal Research
- AI-Powered Solutions
- Risk Solutions
- Accurint
- Identity Verification
- Fraud Detection
- Anti-Money Laundering
- Legal Intelligence
- Professional Services
- Data Protection
- Workflow Automation
- Enterprise Solutions
- Compliance Tools

## Core Platforms & Access

- [LexisNexis Homepage](https://www.lexisnexis.com/en-us): LexisNexis homepage showcasing legal AI, business intelligence, and enterprise solutions
- [Product Login Portal](https://www.lexisnexis.com/en-us/product-login.page): Login portal for LexisNexis products including Lexis+, Lexis+ AI, and Accurint
- [Solution Gateway](https://www.lexisnexis.com/en-us/gateway.page): Gateway page for selecting between legal, risk, and professional service solutions

## Risk Solutions & Compliance

- [LexisNexis Risk Solutions](https://risk.lexisnexis.com): Risk Solutions division offering fraud detection, identity management, and compliance tools
